  "Seamlessly integrates two-factor authentication (TOTP) with stored logins.",

  "Autofill and browser extension simplify routine logins and password generation."

 "cons": [
  "Occasional clunkiness or slow loading of the browser extension.",

 ],
 "overall_experience": "The Google Ads Specialist likely found Bitwarden highly valuable for securely managing numerous client accounts and streamlining their workflow. The integrated two-factor authentication was a significant convenience, eliminating the need for separate authenticator apps. While robust functionality was appreciated, the reviewer may have noted minor frustrations with occasional browser extension performance or the initial learning curve for advanced team-sharing features."
